name: Question 10
problem:
In a particular country, there are two groups of people: those who live in the cities and those who live in the countryside. A study has shown that each decade 

- $12%$ of people who lived in the cities relocate to the countryside, and

- $28%$ of people who lived in the countryside relocate to the cities.

Which of the following tables describes how these people change their preferences each year?
worked_solution:
We are given the following situation for each decade: - $12%$ of people who live in the cities relocate to the countryside. This implies that $88%$ of them remain living in the cities. - $28%$ of people who live in the countryside relocate to the cities. This implies that $72%$ of them remain living in the countryside. Writing this information in tabular form, we obtain the following:
From:
Cities Countryside
To: Cities $0.88$ $0.28$
Countryside $0.12$ $0.72$
Note that we can write a corresponding stochastic matrix as follows: $$ [\begin{aligned}0.88 & 0.28 \\ 0.12 & 0.72\end{aligned}]. $$
